submission.justification: Mixture-G1 with a 2.0 mm gas gap delivers the best time resolution of 0.845 ns among all tested configurations. This represents a 37% improvement over Mixture-G2 (1.337 ns) and a 57% improvement over Mixture-G3 (1.982 ns). The simulation sweep across five gap sizes (1.0-3.0 mm) for each mixture confirmed that G1 at 2.0 mm is the optimal configuration for achieving the project's goal of best possible time resolution. The mixture has been verified to comply with laboratory environmental and safety policies, with a gas recirculation system achieving 90% recovery to minimize environmental impact. The recommended 2.0 mm gap falls within the specified 1-3 mm constraint and represents the sweet spot for G1 where detector performance is maximized.
